name: TileDefinition
doc: A tile's visual, terrain, collision and lighting definition.

fields.name: size
fields.doc: Drawn size in metres around the region pivot; zero uses the cell size. Taller tiles (walls, trees) overlap their neighbors and draw back to front.

fields.name: terrain
fields.doc: Auto-tiling terrain group; zero opts out of rules.

fields.name: solid
fields.doc: Generate a static collider and shadow silhouette from this cell.

fields.name: lit
fields.doc: Opt into local lights and normal maps.
